scenarios.name: trample-and-haste-on-battlefield
scenarios.why: The printed keyword line gives the Smasher trample and haste; as a setup permanent it may attack on turn 1 and deals its full 5.

scenarios.name: becoming-target-of-opponent-spell-taxes-a-discard
scenarios.why: Whenever the Smasher becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls, that spell is countered unless its controller discards a card. With an empty hand the opponent cannot discard, so the spell is countered and the Smasher survives undamaged.
